settings.title: Partner Agreement
settings.subtitle: Review and confirm your agreement to list on Palmera.
terms: Palmera handles bookings and customer payments on your behalf.
You will confirm bookings within your stated response time.
Your Palmera listing price will not be undercut on other booking channels.
You agree to Palmera's cancellation and refund policies for guests.
Palmera will pay out your earnings on your agreed schedule via your chosen method.
You may be featured in Palmera curated collections and promotional materials.

how.label: How it works
how.heading: From “what are we doing tonight?” to a ticket in your pocket.
how.b1d: Tonight in Dakar, curated — not everything, the right things.
how.b2d: Every detail before you commit: what’s included, who runs it, what it costs.
how.b3d: Set your party, invite your circle, split the total in the app. No chasing anyone.
how.b4d: Wave, Orange Money or card. Confirmed in seconds — and every plan earns points.
how.b5d: One QR per guest. Scan at the door, you’re in.
